articles.summary: Your package has been seized by Nigerian Customs. What happens next? Don't panic. This guide reveals the shocking truth about customs seizures, the costly reasons it happens, and the simple steps you can take to reclaim your goods or avoid seizure entirely. This is the only guide you'll ever need.
articles.title: What Happens If Nigerian Customs Seizes Your Package?

articles.summary: This guide unravels the complex world of door-to-door vs. port pickup, revealing the hidden costs of one and the total peace of mind of the other. Find out which method is right for you and how to ensure your shipment arrives without a single surprise.
articles.title: Door-to-Door vs. Port Pickup: Which Shipping Option Is Best?

articles.summary: Worried about how to ship clothes to Nigeria without customs seizing your goods? Discover the hidden costs, required documents, and critical steps to ensure your fashion imports arrive safely, on time, and without a single headache.
articles.title: How to Ship Clothing from the United States of America to Nigeria
